evidence.quote: Alibaba’s Qwen team has released Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo , an accelerated checkpoint of its open-weight Qwen-Image-2.1 model. It generates and edits images in 8 denoising steps instead of the base model’s 40-step default . For developers, that means 5x fewer denoising steps on the same 7B architecture, plus a hosted API option. TL;DR Size: 7
Research license only, so commercial self-hosting needs separate permission. What is Q

title: Alibaba Qwen Releases Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, an 8-Step 7B Image Model
summary: MarkTechPost 报道，阿里 Qwen 发布 Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo，在同一 7B 图像生成架构上将默认采样从 40 步降到 8 步，支持生成与编辑；模型使用研究许可，商业自托管需另行确认授权。
investorNote: 步数减少能缓解生成延迟，但应实测画质、显存和商用许可，不能直接等同于五倍端到端降本。
displayTitle: Qwen 发布 Image 2.1 Turbo，图像生成降至八步采样
narrative: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo 把报道所述的默认图像采样从 40 步降到 8 步，保留生成与编辑能力。八步意味着去噪环节减少，实际端到端速度和质量仍要独立比较。尤其需要看许可：报道标明研究用途，商业自托管不能直接按开放权重来部署。
